title: Radiant Nuclear footer
description: A sandy tan footer in bold white type: a two-line street address and an email at the top, two short link columns (site links on the left, legal links on the right), a centred row of three small social icons and a centred copyright line.
notes: uses the theme's secondary colour as the band and secondary-foreground for the type
social icons come in as nodes (svg, img or lucide icon)
name: radiantnuclear-footer

props.name: address
props.description: the street address, one entry per line

props.description: a contact email, shown and linked

props.name: links
props.description: site links, in the left column

props.name: legal
